text:
Ms Georgine Ponsford
Resident Community Nurse
Community Retirement Home
103 Light Street, Newtown

10/02/2019

Dear Ms Ponsford,
Re Mr Lionel Ramamurthy, 63 years old

Mr Ramamurthy was admitted to Newtown Public Hospital on 04/02/2019 due to Pneumonia. He is now ready for discharge and follow up back into your retirement home. Your further care  would be greatly appreciated.

On admission, Mr Ramamurthy presented with breathing problems. Upon assessment It was found that he has wheezing, fever and generalized pain related to his continuous cough. In addition, it was observed that he was having difficulty of doing his activities of daily living due to shortness of breath.

With the above mentioned symptoms proper management was given. Therefore, it was observed that Mr Ramamurthy had a good progress. To illustrate he is now afebrile with normal inflammatory markers and a weight gain with the help of his dietician. With his physiotherapist assistance it was noted that he is now able to do some of his acitivites. However, he is still having some dry cough which still results to his chest and abdominal pain.

Kindly take note to keep him warm and give Paracetamol if his pain persist. Additionally, maintain him hydrated and keep noting regarding his diet .

Should there be any queries please do not hesistate to contact me.

Sincerely,
Nurse
